title: guided-prefill-optimizer-synthetic-cost-profiles
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Added guided prefill optimizer that generates tenant-specific warmstart and batch/cache defaults from synthetic cost profiles; telemetry hooks for prefill success and fallback rate; CLI dry-run for unit-econ simulation and safe rollout flags.
description:
Context and motivation: production workloads show that a small fraction of tenants generate a disproportionate fraction of cold-start cost. Prior heuristics used static prefill thresholds and one-size quant profiles which required manual tuning. This patch introduces a Guided Prefill Optimizer that uses lightweight synthetic cost profiles (trace-derived micro-simulations) to recommend safe warmstart, batch, and cache defaults per tenant/workload segment and a safety-first quantization probe.
Summary of changes: - New controller: econ/prefill_optimizer that ingests recent trace summaries, runs a small synthetic-replay generator, and derives candidate prefill sizes, cache TTLs, preferred batch shapes, and quant profiles with an explicit safety score. - Quant safety prober: runtime probe that runs short, isolated inference trials on candidate quant profiles and measures loss/regression signals against golden prompts; failures mark a profile as "unsafe" and cause automatic fallback to conservative profile. - CLI tool: tools/econ-sim that allows operators to run dry-runs with a tenant id and a budget target; outputs predicted unit-econ delta and recommended rollout flags. - Telemetry and alerts: added metrics redwood.prefill.recommendation.latency, redwood.prefill.fallback_rate, redwood.prefill.estimated_unit_cost_delta and three new tracing spans to correlate recommendations with actual outcomes. - Config & rollout: feature-flag guarded rollout via ff-prefill-optimizer, and a safe autopause that stops applying recommendations when fallback_rate crosses thresholds.
Design notes and tradeoffs: - Synthetic cost profiles are intentionally conservative: we synthesize short replay batches with varied sequence-length distributions to cover edge-case token growth without replaying full tenant history. This keeps CPU cost low while giving meaningful unit-econ estimates. - We separate recommendation generation from application so teams can preview via CLI and telemetry before enabling automated application. - The quant safety prober runs inference with request-scoped golden prompts to detect silent quality regressions; we rely on small, curated prompt sets per-model family to balance signal vs cost. - We tuned thresholds to minimize false-positives on safety checks; still, rollout is gated and monitored.
Tests and validation performed: - Unit tests for recommendation logic and profile serialization. - Integration tests: synthetic replayer run in CI against small sample traces. - Performance validation: 72h canary in staging with 50 synthetic tenants showing median 12% unit-cost reduction and 99.95th latency delta within SLO. - Safety validation: quant prober caught 2 unsafe quant candidates in the canary and prevented their rollout.
Commits: ["prefill: add guided optimizer controller and API", "tools: add econ-sim CLI and dry-run mode", "runtime: quant safety prober and isolation harness", "telemetry: add prefill metrics and tracing spans", "ui: console toggle and recommendation preview page", "tests: unit and integration tests for optimizer and prober"]
Changed files (high level): ["econ/prefill_optimizer/controller.py - new controller + recommendation schema", "econ/prefill_optimizer/simulator.py - synthetic replay generator and estimator", "runtime/quant/prober.go - quant safety probe harness + probes registry", "tools/econ-sim/main.py - CLI dry-run + report export", "telemetry/metrics_definitions.yaml - new metric definitions", "webapp/src/pages/prefill/preview.tsx - preview UI and opt-in flow", "deploy/feature_flags/ff-prefill-optimizer.yaml - rollout flag", "docs/ops/prefill-optimizer.md - operator runbook and rollback steps", "ci/integration/prefill-smoke.yml - new canary workflow"]
Migration and operator steps: - Run tools/econ-sim --tenant <id> --dry-run to get recommended presets; use --apply flag to opt-in per-tenant. - db migration adds a small recommendations table (backfill script included) but is additive and backwards compatible. - Rollout plan: enable ff-prefill-optimizer for 1% of tenants for 48h, monitor redwood.prefill.fallback_rate and unit-cost deltas; incrementally increase to 25% then 100% if thresholds remain stable. Rollback plan: feature flag disable and a revert job to copy last-known good defaults back to tenant configs.
Security and compliance: recommendations stored encrypted-at-rest and access-controlled via RBAC; prober runs do not expose customer data (uses synthetic/golden prompts only).
Known limitations and follow-ups: - Current synthetic replay ignores cross-request context beyond simple prefix caching models; follow-up ENG-4215 to extend to conversational KV-cache-aware replays. - Some models with brittle quant behavior may require expanded golden prompt sets; ENG-4187 tracks improvements.
Overall impact and rationale: This change automates a large portion of manual prefill/batching/caching tuning, reduces operational burden, and yields measurable unit-cost wins while preserving output quality via the quant safety prober.

review_comments: Luis Ortega: Nice separation between generation and application. One concern: simulator.py may be CPU-heavy if we run many tenants concurrently in the controller. Can we throttle?

Maya Chen (author): Good point. Added a controller-side concurrency cap and a scheduler that batches simulator runs during off-peak windows. See simulator.py change and config 'simulator.max_concurrency'
Priya Nair: Quant prober is critical. Please ensure the golden prompt sets are versioned per-model and stored in the model registry.
Maya Chen (author): Golden prompts are versioned and referenced by model hash; added model_registry reference and tests to assert coverage. See runtime/quant/prober.go
Samir Patel: CI flaked once on the canary job in staging due to infra instability. Confirmed unrelated; re-ran and passed.
QA (automated): Integration smoke failed on first run due to missing env var PREFILL_SIM_TEMP_DIR; fixed in CI workflow change.
